description:
Port the upstream test-harness.ts into an ExUnit support module. Provides:
- A faux Model with declarative response sequencing (text, tool calls, thinking, errors)
- A one-call factory that wires up AgentSession with in-memory deps (SessionManager, ModelRegistry, SettingsManager)
- Event capture helpers for assertions
- Extension factory injection

Upstream: test/test-harness.ts (446 lines) + test/test-harness.test.ts.
This is the foundation — all integration test tickets depend on it.
title: Test harness: faux model + session factory for extension integration tests
